segments.text: Using cursor in your IDE, claude code in your terminal, winds surf for second opinions. Each one has isolated memory. Teach one a rule, the others forget it.
Agentic stack fixes that. One brain, many harnesses. A portable aagent folder that standardizes your AI's memory, custom skills, and protocols. Drop it
into your project and it plugs into Claude code, cursor, windsurf, openclaw or even a custom Python loop.
